=={{header|Omegese}}==
{{works with|omc|sha256 2c824805, aien-dev/omega-mv e5b32567, Linux AArch64}}
Omega has no imports, so the small output helpers (<code>emit</code> and friends) are part of the program.
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
om2
text nl "\n"
text msg "The quick brown fox Jumped over the lazy Dog"
note emit writes every byte of a to stdout; a short write is retried, an error exits 1
fn emit a view uchar * to void
o = ulong 0
while lt o len a bound 4096
k = write 1 a o sub len a o
if le k 0
exit 1
end
o = add o ulong k
end
end
note shift rotates ASCII letters by k places (0..25) into r; other bytes are copied
fn shift a view uchar * r edit uchar * k uchar to void
for i ulong len a
c = get a i
if and ge c 65 le c 90
c = add rem add sub c 65 k 26 65
else
if and ge c 97 le c 122
c = add rem add sub c 97 k 26 97
end
end
put r i c
end
end
fn main to int
n = len msg
e = new uchar 256 0
d = new uchar 256 0
shift msg part e 0 n 11
emit part e 0 n
emit nl
note decoding is a shift by 26 - 11
shift part e 0 n part d 0 n 15
emit part d 0 n
emit nl
ret 0
end
</syntaxhighlight>
{{out}}
<pre>
Esp bftnv mczhy qzi Ufxapo zgpc esp wlkj Ozr
The quick brown fox Jumped over the lazy Dog
</pre>
